chunks: But those who were given the knowledge and belief will say: 'You have tarried, according to the Book of God, as long as the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you do not know.'

key_terms.الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَان: Those who were given knowledge and faith
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: The Book of God (referring to His decree/measurement)

ai.seo_question: What will the people of knowledge say to the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'those given knowledge and faith' (Al--Mu'tafiqun) are often identified as the Ahl al-Bayt or the Imams, who will address the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment. This verse highlights the irony that while the disbelievers were aware of the general concept of resurrection, their spiritual ignorance prevented them from recognizing the reality of the Hereafter during their earthly life, leading to their eventual realization only when it is too late.
